changes.change: Hosting modules, taken by tag as github.com/schryer/pubkit//terraform/<name>?ref=vX.Y.Z: dns-zone writes a zone's records (rrsets in zone-file form) to its Hetzner zone and, with cloudflare set, to a Cloudflare zone in multi-provider mode as well, with both providers' nameservers in the apex NS rrset; mailbox-org outputs mailbox.org's MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC and verification records; static-site makes a Cloudflare Pages project and domain and points the name at it or, with served_by = "server", at a standby server

actions/deploy-static, a composite action that deploys a directory to a server over rsync (with a pinned host key, or one scanned each run) and to Cloudflare Pages through a pinned wrangler, or to both, and fails rather than deploy nowhere or to half a target
deploy-static's scripts use [[ ]] for their tests, as SonarQube Cloud asks (shelldre:S7688)

comment: Changes not yet released. One row per change: category changed or removed (a published interface changed: major), added (a feature: minor), or fixed or security (patch). `pubrel add` appends one; `pubrel summary` sets the release's summary; `pubrel prepare` moves them into the package publet.
